map.由半衰期求平均寿命工具依据 τ=t½/ln2 将半衰期换算为平均寿命，输入半衰期: The mean-life tool converts a half-life to mean life by tau = t1/2 / ln2, taking the half-life in years and outputting tau, suited to converting statistical characteristics of nuclear decay.
map.输入半衰期 t½（年），求平均寿命。: Enter the half-life t1/2 (years) to get the mean life.
map.平均寿命 τ = 半衰期除以 ln2。: Mean life tau = half-life divided by ln2.
map.对比不同 th 的平均寿命。: Compare mean life across different half-lives.
map.：τ = 5730 / 0.693147 ≈ 8267 年，比半衰期长约 44%: : tau = 5730 / 0.693147, about 8267 years, roughly 44% longer than the half-life.
map.：若 th=1 天，则 τ≈1.44 天。: : if th = 1 day, then tau is about 1.44 days.
map.平均寿命与半衰期关系？: Relation between mean life and half-life?
map.τ=th/ln2≈1.4427·th；平均寿命是每个核子在衰变前存活时间的平均。: tau = th/ln2, about 1.4427 x th; the mean life is the average time each nucleus survives before decaying.
map.为何 τ 大于 th？: Why is tau larger than th?
map.因指数分布长尾，平均存活时间大于\"半数衰变\"所需时间。: Because of the long tail of the exponential distribution, average survival time exceeds the time needed for "half to decay".
